input: It saves money on transport. I cycle to work. It also gives me exercise. My main reason is staying active. I don't need a separate workout.
question: Why do you like cycling?

key_issues.message: 句子顺序把次要理由（saves money）放在最前，而用户明确说 "My main reason is staying active"，主线被埋在后面，建议把主要理由提前或明确标记。
"It also gives me exercise" 与 "My main reason is staying active" 语义高度重叠，读起来像两条并列理由，实际是同一件事，容易让听者误以为有两个独立原因。
"gives me exercise" 搭配偏生硬，英语中更常说 "it keeps me active" 或 "it's a good workout"。
"I cycle to work" 作为独立短句插在理由之间，缺少与前后句的连接，显得像补充信息而非支撑理由。

feedback.optimization_summary: 保留了用户全部原有信息（省钱、骑车上班、锻炼、主要理由是保持活跃、不需要额外健身），没有新增任何事实。主要调整是把 "My main reason is staying active" 提前并用破折号引出，让主次关系清晰；把 "gives me exercise" 与 "don't need a separate workout" 合并为因果关系，消除重复感；用 and 把省钱和骑车上班连成一句，减少碎片化短句。
feedback.final_upgraded_answer: It saves money on transport, and I cycle to work. But my main reason is staying active — it gives me exercise, so I don't need a separate workout.
feedback.reference_answer: Honestly, it's the freedom that gets me. When I'm on my bike, I can just weave through side streets and stop wherever something catches my eye — no timetables, no traffic jams. It's also my way of switching off after a long day; the rhythm of pedalling kind of clears my head. And since I started cycling to work instead of driving, I've noticed I'm less stressed and I sleep better. It's one of those rare things that's good for you and actually fun at the same time.
feedback.reference_angle_summary: 独立主线：以“自由感 + 减压 + 实际生活改变”为个人化理由，示例不代表用户经历。
feedback.content_diagnosis: 原回答直接回应了问题，给出了三个理由：省钱、锻炼、保持活跃，并说明不需要额外健身，内容相关且不跑题。主要问题是主次不分：用户自己声明 "My main reason is staying active"，但这句话出现在第三句，前面已经列了两个理由，听者容易把三者当成并列。另外 "gives me exercise" 和 "staying active" 实质是同一理由的两种说法，构成重复。整体展开偏薄，每个理由都只有一句话，没有具体说明。
feedback.structure_diagnosis: 信息顺序为：省钱 → 骑车上班 → 锻炼 → 主要理由（保持活跃）→ 不需要额外健身。逻辑连接几乎为零，五句话之间没有连接词，靠并列堆叠。"I cycle to work" 位置尴尬，既不是理由也不是结论，更像事实补充。最后一句 "I don't need a separate workout" 本应支撑 "staying active"，但被隔开，因果关系没有显性化。
feedback.optimization_advice: 1) 把主要理由放在最前或紧接第一句之后，用 "my main reason is..." 明确标记，避免听者误判主次。2) 把 "gives me exercise" 和 "staying active" 合并成一个理由，不要分成两句。3) 如果想拿更高分，可以补充一个具体细节，例如骑车路线的长度、频率、或哪一段路让你觉得最舒服，但这是你需要自己提供的真实信息，我不替你编造。4) 可以加一个具体场景说明 "staying active" 对你意味着什么，比如不用特意去健身房、通勤时间就完成了运动。

takeaway_expressions.expression: my main reason is staying active
takeaway_expressions.meaning: 我的主要理由是保持活跃
takeaway_expressions.meaning_zh: 我的主要理由是保持活跃
takeaway_expressions.why_useful: 在 IELTS 口语中明确标记主要理由，能立刻建立主次结构，避免理由并列导致重点模糊，适用于所有 "Why do you like..." 类问题。
takeaway_expressions.example: My main reason is staying active, not saving money.
takeaway_expressions.usage_note: 可以放在第一句之后，用 But 或 Actually 引出，效果更自然。

takeaway_expressions.expression: I don't need a separate workout
takeaway_expressions.why_useful: 用具体结果支撑抽象理由，比单纯说 "it's good for me" 更有说服力，且句型可迁移到任何 "省时间/省事" 的场景。
takeaway_expressions.example: I walk to the office, so I don't need a separate workout.
takeaway_expressions.usage_note: 前面加 so 或 which means 能显性化因果关系。

takeaway_expressions.why_useful: "save money on + 名词" 是高频地道搭配，比 "save money for transport" 更准确，适用于购物、出行、生活成本等话题。
takeaway_expressions.example: Cooking at home saves money on takeaway.
takeaway_expressions.usage_note: 介词固定用 on，不要用 for 或 in。

takeaway_expressions.meaning: 最吸引我的是那种自由感
takeaway_expressions.meaning_zh: 最吸引我的是那种自由感
takeaway_expressions.why_useful: 自然表达“喜欢某事的核心原因”，比 I like it because it is free 更地道，可用于爱好、旅行、职业等话题。
takeaway_expressions.example: It's the freedom that gets me — I can work from anywhere.
takeaway_expressions.usage_note: 口语中常用 that gets me 表示“打动我的点”。

takeaway_expressions.meaning: 放松、停止思考工作或压力
takeaway_expressions.meaning_zh: 放松、停止思考工作或压力
takeaway_expressions.why_useful: 高频口语短语，替换 relax，适合描述减压方式、周末活动、爱好。
takeaway_expressions.example: I go for a run after work just to switch off.
takeaway_expressions.usage_note: 常与 after work / at the weekend 搭配。

takeaway_expressions.why_useful: 形象且高频，用于说明运动、散步、独处等带来的心理效果。
takeaway_expressions.example: A walk by the river always clears my head.
takeaway_expressions.usage_note: 主语通常是活动或事物，如 it / a walk / cycling。
